retained_skill: Integrate Postfix virtual-domain delivery with Dovecot passwd-file authentication and TLS IMAP so mail accepted for virtual users is readable through IMAP.
bottleneck: The public task permits Maildir storage anywhere under /var/mail/vhosts/, but every scored attempt used the conventional per-user Maildir subdirectory while the verifier only inspected new, cur and tmp directly beneath each user directory; this layout mismatch was the first common grading failure in all 12 attempts.
change: Repair in the scratch verifier: resolve each user's complete Maildir at either the direct per-user location or its conventional Maildir child, and use that same resolved location for cleanup, SMTP-delivery content checks and structure checks. This removes an unstated pathname choice while leaving virtual delivery, authentication, TLS and service integration entirely to the student. The original signal retained is an actual SMTP delivery followed by IMAP access.
restore: A later hardening can require one exact layout by stating that layout explicitly in the public instruction and then checking it; no supplied configuration or implementation needs withdrawal.
